text: Could you make a promo for Northside Gym with a welcoming gym scene rather than hardcore bodybuilding? I want people to feel comfortable about the idea of going to the gym, because I know it can feel a little intimidating at first. I’m probably overthinking how it will come across, but that’s why I’m explaining it all. It should have upbeat music and no voiceover, and what I’m after is a 10-second vertical video. For the last 5 seconds, please keep all these details on screen together: “Northside Gym”, “18 Cedar Road”, “Mon–Fri 6am–10pm”, “Sat–Sun 8am–6pm”. Make that text big enough to read on a phone.
